attributes.title: Analytics Report Rubric
attributes.purpose: Written analysis handed in as a short report with a chart.

criteria.name: Analysis
criteria.description: Is the reasoning sound and tied to the data?

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Insight a stakeholder would act on; caveats named.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Correct reading of the data with one clear conclusion.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Describes the data without interpreting it.

criteria.name: Visualisation
criteria.description: Does the chart carry the argument?

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: One chart, right type, labelled, no chart junk.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Readable chart that supports the text.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Chart present but misleading or unlabelled.

criteria.name: Communication
criteria.description: Could a busy manager read it in two minutes?

levels.label: Exemplary
levels.descriptor: Lead with the finding; every sentence earns its place.
